body.p: Sturgeon Skin. There lived an old woman with two sons. Her youngest son was a fool. Her eldest son was intelligent. Her eldest son wore a sturgeon skin instead of a lining under his fur coat. He called himself Sturgeon Skin. One day Sturgeon Skin's mother went for water. She wanted to scoop some water, and then a skier came from behind. The skier said: "Wait for me, I'll just put my hands in the water." Then he put his hands into the water. He took his hands out of the water. On his fingers, he took out five nelmas and five sturgeons. He put these fishes on the ice. He said: "If Sturgeon Skin does the same as me, then let him come to visit me tomorrow." The old woman filled her buckets with water and went home. In the evening, her son came. The old woman said: "The Selkup skier said: if your son does the same as me, let him come to visit me.". The old woman told him about the arrival of the skier. They slept one night. The next morning, Sturgeon Skin went to the water, put his hands into the ice hole. He took out five nelmas and five sturgeons. He put it on the ice to freeze it. Then he left. He went along the ski traces of the Selkup skier. Walking like that, he reached the forest. He sees that Selkup skier is torn into two parts. Two of its parts on two sides of the tree are gone. Then they got back together again.[ShA:] The syntax looks rather strange.Sturgeon Skin thinks: "And I can also be torn into two parts." He goes forward again. He sees that Selkup skier left his leg. Sturgeon Skin goes forward again. The Selkup skier left his other leg. Sturgeon Skin still goes forward. A hand remained from the Selkup skier. âSturgeon Skin still goes forward. After some time, the Selkup skier left his other hand. Sturgeon Skin always goes forward. He sees that the Selkup skier has left his torso. Only his head was left, jumping. He reached the tent. There was one blade of grass near the tent. His skis are dangling on one blade of grass. Then his skis entered the tent themselves. Sturgeon Skin also entered the tent. An old man and an old woman are sitting in the tent. An eagle sits on the head of the old man, a hawk sits on the head of the old woman. There was a girl in the tent. Sturgeon Skin looks to the other side. There are riders on the other side. The Selkup skier said: "Skis are necessary." After a while, the old woman began to move, ski noses appeared out of her mouth. He put on his skis and said: "I need to bring you some meat." After a while, a man appeared and brought a reindeer. He put the reindeer he had brought, and said: "One has to cut this reindeer.". The old woman took a knife, poked her old man with a knife. The old man began to cut the reindeer. The Selkup skier said: "Sturgeon Skin, so that you don't eat meat alone, bring yourself a friend from the outside.". Sturgeon Skin went outside. Sturgeon Skin only thinks, says to himself: "Who will I take as a friend to eat meat, who looks like my friend.". He looks here and there. Looking like this, he saw a reindeer caravan. The reindeer of the caravan are all white. A woman is sitting behind the reindeer. The woman stopped. He led the woman by her hand into the tent. They sat down to eat raw meat. He took the woman as his wife. Sturgeon Skin went home with his wife.
